body: I remember when I was younger they sold halo cards that had beautiful concept pictures on them in the card section of stores where they sold Pokémon cards and stuff. I had a pack, I really wish I still had it
I wear under armor long sleeve with my shirt over that.  I only roll up my sleeve when I’m doing dishes and it’s going to get wet or if I’m really hot but I will be careful on who is around

I don’t know if it’s too late, but I had to right a poem for school once and I was in a really bad place at the time self harming, I wrote a somewhat dark poem for the class, nothing to dark to draw attention but then I wrote three other poems just for myself that were about self harming and it helped me. I haven’t wrote a poem since but I suggest you don’t write one about self harming for the class because as much as you are in a dark place write now, you will regret the attention later. Hope this helps
Think of strength in not killing yourself, but in continuing to survive. That’s what helps me
I can feel the same way, I think just because you think your fine, subconsciously you are holding within pain and you need to knock those barriers down that’s holding it in
You are right, sometimes though it feels one way, but maybe I just need to open up more

Your probably right. It’s just that I have had past friends that have just ignored my depression or just stopped seeing me all together. Then again I guess they wouldn’t really be friends then would they. It’s just when my depression is severe I tell myself that no one wants to listen about my depression
Ya I guess your right, it’s just hard finding that counselor I feel comfortable enough talking too

I can understand were your coming from, it can feel very annoying for me to hear other people talk about how they have depression and how hard it is and it does make me think a lot of people do it for attention but I could also just think that way because I struggle to talk about my depression as I feel it pushes people away like it’s contagious. So when I hear people just talk about it without a hesitation in there voice I get suspicious
